SuaveUI is an experimental PWA chat UI built specifically for interacting with Local AI Models.

![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/7735415/364991014-6446ba15-e13e-44cb-b3f2-c060f1333a38.gif?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Uq16xW7Q6fFksi8lXLDjEsMu4VZtB-ynecKxyMZ35jY)

![](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/7735415/364992132-f5ff4773-2958-4228-8b32-5abb78db9d83.gif?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..iQp7Xfujzt3u1hVCe-i31OpnHr0qfuc90TYHGNURreM)

You can easily run the latest version of SuaveUI using Docker. Follow these steps:

-
**Pull the latest image:**docker pull ghcr.io/avarayr/suaveui:latest

-
**Run the container:**docker run -p 3005:3005 --add-host localhost:host-gateway ghcr.io/avarayr/suaveui:latest

-
Go to http://localhost:3005


While SuaveUI is in early alpha, installation is via cloning and running a server

Requirements: Bun, Node

`git clone https://github.com/avarayr/suaveui`

`bun install`

`bun dev`


React for UI, Node.js as light backend
